'''Debasisa Mohanty''' (born 30 November 1966) is an Indian computational biologist, bioinformatician and a staff scientists at the [[National Institute of Immunology, India]]. Known for his studies on structure and function prediction of proteins, [[genome analysis]] and computer simulation of [[Biomolecule|biomolecular systems]], Mohanty is an elected fellow of all the three major Indian science academies namely the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], the [[Indian National Science Academy]] and the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]]. The [[Department of Biotechnology]] of the Government of India awarded him the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]], one of the highest Indian science awards, for his contributions to biosciences, in 2009.

== Biography ==
[[File:A building at IIT Kanpur.jpg|thumb|left|IIT Kanpur]]
Born on 30 November 1966,<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Mohanty,_Dr_Debasisa |title=Fellow profile |date=2018-01-21 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref> Debasisa Mohanty earned a post graduate degree (MSc) in physics from the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur]] in 1988 and did his doctoral studies at the Molecular Biophysics Unit of the [[Indian Institute of Science]] to secure a PhD in computational biophysics in 1994.<ref name="About the speaker">{{Cite web |url=http://www.mecheng.iisc.ernet.in/~spapro/Dmohanty.htm |title=About the speaker |date=2018-01-21 |website=www.mecheng.iisc.ernet.in |access-date=2018-01-21 |archive-date=22 January 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180122071819/http://www.mecheng.iisc.ernet.in/~spapro/Dmohanty.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> Subsequently, he completed his post-doctoral work, first the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] and, later, at the [[Scripps Research Institute]].<ref name="Debasisa  Mohanty on NII">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nii.res.in/research/debasisa-mohanty |title=Debasisa Mohanty on NII |date=2018-01-21 |website=www.nii.res.in |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref> On his return to India, he joined the [[National Institute of Immunology, India]] (NII) where he serves as a Grade VII staff scientist and hosts a number of research scholars at his laboratory. He currently hold director position at NII. At NII, he also supervises the activities of ''RiPPMiner'', (Bioinformatics Resource for Deciphering Chemical Structures of RiPPs)<ref name="RiPPMiner">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nii.ac.in/~priyesh/lantipepDB/new_predictions/contactus.php |title=RiPPMiner |date=2018-01-21 |website=www.nii.ac.in |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref> and the Bioinformatics Centre.<ref name="Bioinformatics Centre">{{Cite web |url=http://www.cosidici.com/INSTITUTES/NATIONAL%20INSTITUTE%20OF%20IMMUNOLOTY.htm |title=Bioinformatics Centre |date=2018-01-21 |website=Council Of State Industrial Development and Investment Corporations Of India (COSIDICI) |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref>

Mohanty resides at the NII Campus, along Aruna Asaf Ali Marg in [[New Delhi]].<ref name="NASI fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=M |title=NASI fellows |date=2018-01-21 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref>

== Legacy ==
[[File:Genome viewer screenshot small.png|thumb|A partially sequenced [[genome]].]]
Mohanty's research focus is in the fields of [[computational biology]] and [[bioinformatics]]<ref name="Indian fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail/P13-1617 |title=Indian fellow |date=2018-01-21 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy |access-date=2018-01-21 |archive-date=22 January 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180122072004/http://insaindia.res.in/detail/P13-1617 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and he is known to have developed computational methods for predicting the substrate specificity of proteins as well as identified [[biosynthetic]] pathways.<ref name="About the speaker" /> His work has assisted in widening the understanding of the function of putative proteins in [[genomes]] and the ''[[protein interaction]] networks in newly sequenced genomes''.<ref name="Debasisa  Mohanty on NII" /> His studies have been documented by way of a number of articles<ref name="On Google Scholar">{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ivcDx2gAAAAJ |title=On Google Scholar |date=2018-01-20 |publisher=Google Scholar |access-date=2018-01-20}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and [[ResearchGate]], an online repository of scientific articles has listed 108 of them.<ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Debasisa_Mohanty |title=On ResearchGate |date=2018-01-20 |access-date=2018-01-20}}</ref>

Mohanty was a member of the national organizing committee of the ''International Conference in Bioinformatics (INCOB)'' held in 2006 in India
<ref name="INCOB 2006">{{Cite web |url=https://incob.apbionet.org/incob06/committee.html |title=INCOB 2006 |date=2018-01-21 |website=incob.apbionet.org |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref> and has delivered invited speeches at various conferences which included the seminar series on ''Proteomics and bioinformatics'' of the [[Regional Centre for Biotechnology]] held in 2013,<ref name="Proteomics and bioinformatics">{{Cite web |url=http://www.rcb.res.in/upload/2013/Workshop2013_5.pdf |title=Proteomics and bioinformatics |date=2013 |website=Regional Centre for Biotechnology |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref> the ''Symposium on Accelerating Biology 2017: Delivering Precision'' of the [[Centre for Development of Advanced Computing]] (C-DAC) held in January 2017 in Pune,<ref name="Accelerating Biology 2017: Delivering Precision">{{Cite web |url=https://cdac.in/index.aspx?id=pdf_SYMP2017_technical_programme_final |title=Accelerating Biology 2017: Delivering Precision |date=2018-01-21 |website=Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref> and the ''Symposium on Functional Genomics'' organized by the [[Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology]] in Delhi in December 2017.<ref name="CCB@IIIT-Delhi">{{Cite web |url=http://ccb.iiitd.ac.in/CCB-group-meeting.html |title=CCB@IIIT-Delhi |date=2018-01-21 |website=ccb.iiitd.ac.in |language=en |access-date=2018-01-21}}</ref>
